Global public source directory & methodology

Prices are spot benchmarks, not futures settlements. Daily changes use the latest observation on or before seven calendar days earlier; weekly and monthly series use the preceding observation. Gaps are not interpolated. Product supplied is an apparent demand proxy. Crack spreads use matched dates and 42 gallons per barrel; they exclude operating costs.
